page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Two marginal notes in the right margin, beside the verse section. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: profperitat in rebus caducis pofita: deinde,fecundum cauffam vt cauffam. Etenim terrenarum rerum copia, neminem verè beatum efficit: quod eò notandum,eft ne illarum fulgore oculos nobis perftringi vn quam patiamur.

Sed quodnam aduerfus hanc tentatio-nem,homo pius remedium adhibebit? Illud ipsum quod etiam Dauid pfal. 4.7. Dedisti laeticiam in corde meo maiorem, quā quae eft tempore, quo vinum & frumentu ipforum multiplicantur. Difcamus,rectè æ-stimare & magnificere fpiritualia bona,&c ante omnia quęrere regnum Dei & eius iu-stitiam: caetera enim adijcientur nobis. Matt.6,13[?]
main_text.head: VERSVS XIII. XIIII.

p.i: Itaque frustrà mundaui cor meum, & abluìnnocentia manus meas. Namfui af-flictu quotidiè,& correptio mea fuit fingulis matutinis.

main_text.p: Quum expofuiffet eorum, qui à facro vitæ instituto ad profanum deflexerunt: nunc quid ipfimet prophetæ, carnis intemperiè & prauas fuggeftiones, experienti,in mentem venerit,confitetur.
Grauis autem hæc tentatio eft,quū caro

page.notes: Page number "151" is a worn glyph, read as 151 with doubt. The reference "Matt.6,13" is read from a worn numeral; Matt. 6:33 is the expected verse, so the printed number is uncertain. The word after "af-" is worn; "flictu" is uncertain. The marginal reference "13Maij." is doubtful. The line "abluìnnocentia" appears to lack a space in print. Long s is written as plain s; the hyphen in "æ-stimare" and "iu-stitiam" is printed.
